review:
The summery 10-line sequel to Wild Cash, with a much bigger ceiling: 10,490x.

Three, four or five bonus symbols trigger the bonus, and four add a 3x multiplier, five add 10x – so the trigger itself decides a lot. It looks simple, but it's very high volatility, with a 96.1% RTP. Big swings hide behind that clean design.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
